The Musée Jean-de-La-Fontaine in Château-Thierry developed through the town’s historical society in the nineteenth century. Its collections explore the writer and the reception of his work.

Paintings, sculpture, drawings, prints and furnishings connect La Fontaine’s life with later artistic interpretations of his fables, including drawings by Jean-Baptiste Oudry.
